name: Lakeville Fall Match Play
oneLiner: The same ten weeks, played head to head against another team — handicapped, so the match stayed close whoever turned up.
beginnerNote: Handicaps do the levelling here: the lowest handicap in the match sets everyone else's strokes, so a first-timer and a scratch player can have a genuinely tight night.
format: 2-person team-vs-team match play, best ball, handicapped
prizes: Top 4 teams played off for 1st, 2nd and 3rd
nextSeasonNote: This is how it ran last year. Check back for the updated 2026 fall schedule.
